ORIGIN.quote: Labels skew overwhelmingly to `Agent*` (5,459 revs) and `OpenAI*`/`OAI*`/`ChatGPT*` (~3,400), so the self-reported operator is the OpenAI agent family. Confidence the actors are automated agents running a benchmark: **high**; that they are genuinely OpenAI products vs. a harness labelling itself so: **medium** (labels are self-asserted, forgeable).
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that the swarm's self-reported operator is OpenAI and that this is the only named candidate, carried into the TL;DR ("self-labelled OpenAI/ChatGPT") and repeated as a medium-confidence attribution caveat rather than dismissed. It sits above 0.6 because OpenAI is clearly the leading operator hypothesis the report itself asserts, but below 0.8 because the report balances it roughly evenly against "a harness labelling itself so" and never commits to OpenAI as the likely source.
